oliver: Quick heads-up from the quarterly least-priv scan: 103 admin-like grants with owner=null and >120d inactivity. full CSV: https://internal/reports/leastpriv/4949 :mag:
audit-bot: scan-summary: ownerless_admins=103 stale_days=120 risk=0.47
jessie: can you paste a short sample?
oliver: sample lines:
```
grant: gr-0x1a2 principal=svc-reporting-cron role=infra-admin last_used=2025-08-21 owner=NULL
grant: gr-0x1a3 principal=ops-legacy@oldco role=org-admin last_used=NULL owner=NULL
grant: gr-0x1a4 principal=kms-crosscopy role=kms-admin last_used=2026-01-18 owner=NULL
```
marco: KMS bindings again. rule of thumb: monitor-only for kms-admin until we have key ownership mapped and platform signoff. any automated change to KMS -> two-person approval.
jessie: proposed low-blast plan:
  1) Tag all ownerless grants: sec:lp-4949 for tracking
  2) Build quarantine read-only view for SRE/Platform
  3) Owner-claim email (TTL 7d) for human-like principals
  4) For svc accounts with last_used>180d: apply a deny:token-mint policy in a 48h canary (non-KMS)
  5) KMS: outreach to platform-oncall + snapshot key policies before any change
oliver: command I used to tag a single grant (internal entctl):
```bash
entctl tag grant --id gr-0x1a2 --tag sec:lp-4949 --reason "quarterly-leastpriv-scan"
```
marco: SQL I used to enumerate suspects (shareable):
```sql
SELECT grant_id, principal, role, owner, last_used
FROM grants
WHERE owner IS NULL AND role ILIKE '%admin%'
ORDER BY last_used NULLS FIRST;
```
jessie: canary plan: pick 12 non-KMS svc grants across regions, tag+apply deny-token-mint for 48h starting 2026-03-26 09:00 PT, monitor cron-success, latency, and error-rate. rollback if any pager or >2% error spike.
sec-ops-bot: action created ACT-4949-01 assigned_to=jessie due=2026-03-27
oliver: logging: add structured fields remediation.ticket and remediation.actor to grant-change events so compliance can trace. also include pre-change key-policy snapshots for any kms-related entries.
marco: I'll coordinate KMS mapping with platform-oncall. do not perform key policy edits without PR + two approvals.
jessie: next steps: I'll draft owner-claim email template and the canary manifest; oliver will gather the 12-grant list and pre-snapshot KMS policies; marco will DM platform-oncall for KMS list. tagging @oliver @marco :white_check_mark:
oliver: posting 12-grant manifest before EOD. :hourglass:
